name: Inventory distinct codes
context: How many different non-null warehouse batch codes appear? Repeated codes are counted once.

name: Keep repeats
context: Do not deduplicate. Count all non-null answers, including repeated answers and zero.

name: Missing included
context: Do not exclude missing values. Count the number of rows, including every null entry.

name: Zero-only measured
context: Count observed values that are not null. Zero and false are observations, not missing.
